ValidationRule.description: Prevents modification of immutable version binding fields after initial insert (SF-07).
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: NOT(ISNEW()) && (ISCHANGED(Binding_Key__c) || ISCHANGED(Content_Hash__c) || ISCHANGED(Content_Version_Id__c) || ISCHANGED(Content_Document_Id__c) || ISCHANGED(Format__c) || ISCHANGED(Artifact_Set_Id__c) || ISCHANGED(Artifact_Id__c))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Binding key, content hash, remote IDs, and format are immutable once registered.
